readback.name: Poincare.ParabolicSpatialPullbackChainRule.hasFDerivAt_graph_covector_pullback
readback.mathematical_statement: E3 is EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3), the real three-dimensional Euclidean vector space in Type 0. Y alpha T V is the pinned normed graph space of total V-valued functions on R x E3 that are zero off the closed cylinder Icc 0 T times all of E3 and have bounded values and bounded scaled differences within that cylinder. Its norm is the value supremum plus the alpha-Hoelder seminorm over distinct ordered cylinder pairs, whose denominator is D(p,q)^alpha with D((t,x),(s,y)) = norm(x-y) + sqrt(abs(t-s)). The inserted zero in these suprema specifies the empty-set case. Y has no separate approximation, smoothness, or continuity condition across the endpoints of the zero extension. Graph alpha T has four Y fields: scalar u and ut, covector du, and continuous-bilinear-form-valued ddu, the latter represented as E3 ->L[R] E3 ->L[R] R. Its norm is the sum of the four Y norms. Its certificates state u(0,x) = 0 for every x; for every t in Icc 0 T and every x, the ordinary spatial Frechet derivative of z |-> u(t,z) is du(t,x), and that of z |-> du(t,z) is ddu(t,x); and the within-Icc 0 T time derivative of s |-> u(s,x) is ut(t,x). The first argument of ddu is the derivative direction and the second is the argument at which the resulting covector is evaluated. These time certificates do not assert an ordinary ambient time derivative at either endpoint or joint C3 regularity at initial time. For every total globally C-infinity F : E3 -> E3, every real alpha,T, every G in Graph alpha T, every t in Icc 0 T, and every x in E3, the covector-valued total function H(z) = G.du(t,F(z)).comp (DF_z) has a Frechet derivative at x equal to the displayed continuous-linear-map sum. Here DF_z = fderiv R F z and D2F_x = fderiv R (fderiv R F) x. Applied first to a variation v and then to a covector argument w, that derivative is G.ddu(t,F(x))(DF_x(v))(DF_x(w)) + G.du(t,F(x))(D2F_x(v)(w)). The compL operator maps a covector ell and a linear map D to ell.comp D. Its flip at DF_x is the map ell |-> ell.comp DF_x, and composing this with G.ddu(t,F(x)).comp DF_x gives the first term, with DF_x applied in both slots. Applying compL to G.du(t,F(x)) and composing with D2F_x gives the second term. Thus the second-derivative term is present with a plus sign and its first argument is v, second w. C-infinity means ContDiff at the ENat top injected into WithTop ENat. The declaration has no universe parameters and assumes no compact support, Lipschitz bound, linearity, injectivity, or inverse for F. There is no restriction on alpha and no positivity restriction on T apart from the existence of the specified t; for T < 0 the t-membership premise has no witnesses, and T = 0 is included. This is an ordinary spatial derivative statement at every x for a fixed admissible time, with no claimed operator norm estimate or constructed Graph pullback.
